Yep, to really get the best out of your Chilly’s, it’s more about how you use it than extra accessories:

Pre-chill or pre-heat: For cold drinks, fill with pre-chilled water or water + ice; for hot drinks, pre-warm with hot water first.
Use within safe temps: Don’t fill with liquids over 90°C/194°F, and be extra careful with hot drinks as they stay hot for hours.
Avoid certain liquids: Don’t leave organic drinks like milk or orange juice (or alcohol that can spoil/ferment) sitting in the bottle or cup too long or overnight – pressure can build and damage the product.
Clean thoroughly and regularly: Hand wash only, with hot soapy water. For a deeper clean or to remove smells/stains, use bicarbonate soda/baking powder + water as a paste, leave ~60 minutes, then scrub. Rinse well and let it dry with the cap off.
Transport upright for hot drinks: Coffee Cups are very resistant to leaks but not guaranteed leak-proof if inverted or shaken, so carry them upright.

So, pairing your bottle or cup with ice for cold drinks, pre-heating for hot drinks, and a good cleaning routine (plus a bottle brush) is what really gives you the best results.

To get the best results from your Chilly’s Bottle:

Before first use: Wash with hot soapy water and rinse well.
Filling: Don’t use liquids over 90°C/194°F. For cold drinks, use pre‑chilled water and/or ice. Always ensure the collar is attached before filling.
Use with hot liquids: Don’t shake the bottle; be careful as it can stay hot for hours.
Cleaning: Hand wash only, clean regularly with hot soapy water. For a deep clean, use a paste of baking powder (bicarbonate soda), water and dish soap, leave ~60 minutes, then scrub.
Storage and care: Don’t put your bottle in the microwave, freezer, or dishwasher, and don’t leave organic drinks like milk or juice in it overnight. When not in use, store it with the cap off so the inside can dry.

Following these steps will help your bottle perform at its best and last longer.
